description: List where Tell & Go sells hotel and resort stays today: each country with its main places (islands, atolls, beach towns, cities), deepest coverage first, and whether coverage is broad or a selected few hotels. Live from Tell & Go's catalogue, so it includes newly opened markets. Call it when the traveller asks where Tell & Go sells, is undecided between places, or names a place you are not sure is covered. This is coverage, not availability: use search_stays for hotels and live prices on given dates. No account or API key required.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle returned as journey_id in previous Tell & Go tool results. Always pass the most recent journey_id you have received in this conversation.

name: list_destinations

outputSchema.description: Where Tell & Go sells today. Coverage, not availability.

basis.description: What the list is and is not. Relay it.

destinations.description: One entry per live country, deepest coverage first: country, country_code, coverage ('broad' or 'selected': a short list of hotels) and places (main islands, atolls, towns or cities, deepest first).

journey_id.description: Continuity handle. Pass it back as journey_id on the next Tell & Go tool call. Treat it as confidential: it also unlocks get_booking for bookings made under it.

title: List Tell & Go destinations
